opportunities.name: Weekend trip planning end-to-end
opportunities.description: For a destination city and dates: look up the city on Wikipedia and timeanddate weather, search Booking.com hotels, find a Viator activity or two, find an OpenTable dinner, then save a summary note and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, opentable, notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article (population)
Search the city on timeanddate and open its Weather page (temperature)
On Booking.com enter the destination, pick check-in/out dates, set travelers, search and open the top hotel (price)
On Viator search activity queries and open the top result for each
On OpenTable search the cuisine and city, set the date, party size, Find a table, open the top restaurant
In Notes add a one-line summary with population, temperature, hotel, price, activities, dinner
In Mail compose a message to the friend with subject and body summarizing the plan, then discard

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search by destination, dates and guests
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a destination with check-in/out dates and adult count, then open the top hotel result.
steps: Click destination field, select all, type city
Choose the matching suggestion
Open date picker and select check-in and check-out dates
Open occupancy and adjust adults, click Done
Click Search
Open top hotel result and note its price

opportunities.name: OpenTable restaurant search by cuisine, date, party size
opportunities.description: Search OpenTable for a cuisine and city, set date and party size, and open the top restaurant.
steps: Click the search box, clear it, type cuisine and city
Open the date selector, go to the right month, pick the day
Set party size
Click Find a table
Open the top restaurant details

opportunities.name: Viator activity search and open top result
opportunities.description: Search Viator for an activity query and open the first result.
steps: Click search box, select all
Type query
Click the 'Search for ...' option
Open the first result

opportunities.name: City facts lookup: Wikipedia then timeanddate weather
opportunities.description: Look up a city on Wikipedia for population and then its current weather on timeanddate.
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article
Open timeanddate search, type the city, press Enter
Open the Weather link for the city and read temperature

opportunities.name: Save trip note and draft email summary
opportunities.description: Add a summary note of the trip and compose then discard an email to a friend.
steps: Click New note, type summary, press Enter
Open new message, fill To, Subject, Body
Click Discard
